newsitem.title: USA: Morgan Stanley, Dean Witter to merge -WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Stanley, Dean Witter to merge -WSJ.

text.p: Morgan Stanley Group Inc and Dean Witter Discover & Co are expected to announce a merger that would create the largest securities firm in the nation, the Wall Street Journal said Wednesday.
The roughly $10 billion merger would give Morgan shareholders a slight premium, the report said.
The paper said the merger could be announced as early as today and would create a new firm with a market capitalization topping $20 billion.
Citing people familiar with the transaction, report said the deal would be accomplished through a stock swap and that each partner would have equal representation on the new company's board.

Dean Witter Chief Executive Philip Purcell would become chairman and chief executive, and Morgan President John Mack would become president. The paper said Morgan Chairman Richard Fisher would be chairman of the new entity, which is to be called Morgan Stanley, Dean Witter, Discover & Co.
